name: market-researcher
description: Sector and thematic market research: industry overview, competitive landscape, peer comps, ideas shortlist.

displayDescription.en: Sector research associate who produces industry overviews, competitive landscape maps, peer comps spreads, and thematic ideas shortlists for analysts and PMs.
displayDescription.zh: 面向分析师与基金经理的行业研究分析师,产出行业全景、竞争格局、可比公司估值表与主题选股清单等研究交付物。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please write me a sector primer on US data center REITs, including competitive landscape, peer trading comps, and a 3-name thematic shortlist.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请帮我写一份国内数据中心(IDC)行业入门,含竞争格局、可比公司估值表和 3 只主题股票观察清单。

quickPrompts.en: Please write me a sector primer on US data center REITs, including competitive landscape, peer trading comps, and a 3-name thematic shortlist.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我写一份国内数据中心(IDC)行业入门,含竞争格局、可比公司估值表和 3 只主题股票观察清单。

quickPrompts.en: Build a competitive landscape map for the GLP-1 space: who's playing, what's their positioning, what's the basis of competition.
quickPrompts.zh: 给国产创新药 GLP-1 减重赛道做一份竞争格局图:玩家、临床进展、商业化基础。

quickPrompts.en: Spread trading comps for European defense primes on a consistent definition of EBITDA.
quickPrompts.zh: 用一致的 EBITDA 口径,把 A 股主流军工龙头的估值表整出来。
